Headline: Relink Identical Footage
Description: Relinks identical footage from folders with the same name as the selected folder. Does not detect duplicates within a folder or delete files.

Headline: Scale Down Entire AE Project
Description: Scales all compositions and precompositions in the project to 50% while keeping their layout consistent.

Headline: Crop the Comp
Description: Changes the size of the active composition with an anchor selector, similar to Photoshop Canvas Size.
